title: As Near as Your Next Breath
core_idea: Some traditions picture Source not as something far away but as near as the breath, so a single slow breath can become a simple way of returning.
text: We often imagine the sacred as something far away. Above the clouds, beyond the stars, waiting at the end of a long search. But some traditions picture Source very differently: as near as your next breath. Air comes in, unasked for. It goes out, freely given. You did not earn it, and you cannot keep it. In that view, every breath is a small exchange with the life that holds everything. You don't need to believe it to try it. Just once, breathe in slowly, and notice that this breath was simply given to you. Then let it go. Perhaps returning home is never more than one breath away.
description: A quiet reflection on one image of Source: not far away, but as near as your own breath.
